data: Which segmentation methods are presented in the figure?

The figure shows test performance (accuracy) in the FGET task for different segmentation methods in data scarcity simulation experiments across 4 languages representing 4 broad morphological types, averaged over 5 runs. The legend indicates the following segmentation methods:

- morf (blue line)
- charn (orange line)
- bpele3 (green line)
- bpele4 (red line)
- bpele5 (purple line)
- ft (brown line)
- w2v (pink line)
- bert (gray line)

The figure includes six subfigures, each corresponding to one of the four languages (TR, EN, HE, ZH). Each subfigure contains three graphs showing the test accuracy for different training sizes (FGET training size = 200, 2000, 20000) and WE training size. The lines represent the performance of the segmentation methods across these conditions.
